Analytical derivatives of Sigma_b with respect to eta (C++ kernel)

Source: R/RcppExports.R
cpp_precision_derivatives.Rd

Since Sigma_b = K_b^-1 and dK_b/deta_d = Z_d, the derivative is dSigma_b/deta_d = -Sigma_b Z_d Sigma_b; each matrix is symmetrized.

Usage

cpp_precision_derivatives(Sigma_b, bases)

Arguments

Sigma_b

the R x R covariance matrix.

bases

numeric cube R x R x q_G of base matrices Z_d, with q_G the number of graph parameters.

Value

list of q_G symmetric matrices, each -Sigma_b Z_d Sigma_b.
